title: Nutty Juicy Dutch Steak Skewers
description: A festive Dutch-inspired steak skewer packed with nutty crunch and tandoor‑style flavor, perfect for egg‑free gatherings.

ingredients.name: Tandoor spice mix
ingredients.notes: smoked paprika 1 tsp, cumin 1 tsp, garam masala 1 tsp, coriander 1 tsp, chili powder 1 tsp

instructions: Preheat a grill or Dutch oven to high heat to simulate a tandoor.
Whisk together almond butter, soy sauce, maple syrup, tandoor spice mix, lemon juice, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Add the beef cubes, toss to coat, cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Thread marinated beef onto skewers, alternating pieces with chopped pistachios.
Brush the skewers lightly with olive oil.
Grill the skewers over high heat, turning every 2 minutes, until the meat has a charred crust and reaches an internal temperature of 60°C (medium‑rare); this should take about 8–10 minutes total.
Remove from the grill, let rest for 5 minutes, then sprinkle with extra pistachios and fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve hot with a side of Dutch mustard or a cucumber‑yogurt dip.
